analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 33.2 entering oversold territory, attempting a rebound after 5 consecutive down days. The 5-day low of $225.57 matches the 20-day low, confirming support. MACD histogram remains negative, but 4H RSI at 26.1 shows potential for a bounce from oversold. ADX at 24.2 is in the early stages of trend formation.
